messages.subject: Executive Candidate | Mining, Renewable Energy, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Horizon Global Hires Team,

Your focus on mining and renewable energy is closely aligned with my current executive experience. I serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, where my remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and cross-functional operating delivery.

I am internationally mobile and interested in Director, Head, Country and senior strategic roles across mining, energy transition, sustainability, external affairs, partnerships and business development.

Please find my executive CV attached. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding relevant mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
